paite: Pathian aw, hon humbit ding in kin inla; TOUPA aw, hon panpih ding in kin meng in.
heading: David La / Panpihna Ngetna Leh Suunna / (Sam 40.13-17)
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Yahweh.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlak in zum uhen, ka siatna zong a kipakte.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

paite: Ku! Ku! chite azahlak ziak un taikeksak in om uhen.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

paite: Ahon zong tengteng nangmah ah nuamtak leh kipaktak in om uhenla; na hotdamna itte'n, Pathian pahtawi in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

paite: Himahleh kei zaw genthei leh tagahtak ka hi a; Pathian aw, ka kiang ah hong pai meng in, nang hon panpihpa leh hon humbitpa na hi a; TOUPA aw, sawt hal mahmah ke'n.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
